title.narrative: Hand to Hand Community Kenya Rehabilitation Project

description.narrative: Partner: Hand to Hand Community KenyaProject Title: 'Rescue, Rehabilitation and vocational training for young people living on the streets of Nairobi, Kajiado and Machakos Counties'Project Objectives: - To enable 50 young adults to live lives free from harmful drug and substance use and away from the streets by June 2022.- To provide education, sustainable skills through vocational training or apprenticeship for each client on completing the rehabilitation program.- To create a strong networks of collaborative partnerships (NGOs, CBOs, FBOs and Government agencies) and work closely with such organizations ito reach more clients in need of drug rehabilitation and after care services.- To develop the capacity of HHCK staff and establish the organization as an effective, independent and legal institution with the status of a nationally accredited provider of drug rehabilitation services. Project Activities: Psychosocial support, medical assessments, Awareness creation and sensitization, rehabilitation support for young adults, life skills and vocational skills training
